criteria.name: Structural read
criteria.notes: Takes a real, fair position. Docked because the thesis is distributed across two paragraphs and never lands the dossier's sharpest formulation, that the binding constraint is interconnection rather than zoning.

criteria.name: Forward implication

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, structural, Alaska-first, plainspoken. One drift: the bullet block is comma-chained docket shorthand rather than post_001's full-sentence bullets, and several compounds read clipped.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)

criteria.name: Engagement question
